name: Bauhaus Block
tagline: Warm paper ground with primary red, deep blue and yellow geometric blocks, ruled grid lines and heavy Inter Tight headlines (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: warm off-white paper with ink-black rules and Bauhaus primary red, deep blue and yellow blocks

typography.style: tight heavy grotesk headlines over a neutral sans body with wide-tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Design-led talks that want a strong geometric identity: exhibitions, studio reviews, design-history lectures. Works for any content that benefits from big numbers and clear structure.
avoid_for: Soft, emotional or luxury storytelling where hard geometry and primary colors feel too loud.
